description: Lists terminated listings for one visible store. First resolve the store with hgr_list_channels, then call this tool using channelOAuthId from the selected store. Supports fields, sortBy, sortDirection, limit and pagination declared by HGRApi. Terminated listings do not expose price or stock fields. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

fields.description: Fields to return. Use projection for compact answers.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. HGRApi maximum is 10000.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort before limit/pagination.

name: hgr_get_terminated_listings
title: Get Terminated Listings
